desc: Diffing supplement prose against old sources
code:
def prose(t): return [p.strip() for p in t.split('\n\n') if p.strip() and not p.startswith(' ') and not p.startswith('|') and not p.startswith('-') and not re.match(r'^\d+\. ',p.strip())]
NPp=prose(T['sup']); 
OPall=[(s,p) for s in ['osup','oman'] for p in prose(T[s])]
out=[]
for i,p in enumerate(NPp):
    scores=[difflib.SequenceMatcher(None,p,q,autojunk=False).ratio() if abs(len(p)-len(q))<3*len(p)+200 else 0 for s,q in OPall]
    j=max(range(len(scores)),key=scores.__getitem__)
    out.append((i,scores[j],OPall[j][0],p,OPall[j][1]))
with open('diff.txt','w') as fh:
    for i,r,s,p,q in out:
        if r>0.995: fh.write(f"### {i} IDENTICAL ({s}) {p[:60]}\n\n"); continue
        fh.write(f"### {i} ratio={r:.2f} src={s}\nNEW: {p}\nOLD: {q}\n\n")
print(len(NPp), sum(1 for o in out if o[1]>0.995))

def resolve(cur,txt):
    if cur in txt: return cur
    pat=re.escape(cur).replace('\\ ','[ \u00a0]')
    m_=re.search(pat,txt)
    return m_.group(0) if m_ else None
def add(loc,cur,prob,rep,sev,src='sup'):
    txt=T[src]; act=resolve(cur,txt)
    assert act is not None, ('NOT FOUND',cur[:80])
    for a,b in re.findall(r'(\S+)\u00a0(\S+)',act):
        rep=rep.replace(f"{a} {b}",f"{a}\u00a0{b}")
    n=txt.count(act)
    F.append(dict(location=loc,current_text=act,problem=prob+('' if n==1 else f' [note: this string occurs {n} times; replace each occurrence]'),replacement_text=rep,severity=sev))
